notes:
## Fixed

- Restore responsive windows during Quit and permission recovery when earlier windows are slow. Prioritize first attempts and newly queued windows before retries, with at most four active restoration operations and one shared two-second budget.
- Report unfinished restoration explicitly while preserving process-generation checks, manual window geometry, cancellation and draining of old writers.

## Performance

- Read tracked-window geometry in one CoreGraphics query for the exact requested window IDs instead of querying every window and discarding unrelated descriptions.
- Allow the one-second idle timer to coalesce wakeups without changing the fast tracking cadence.
- Remove unused Accessibility capability helpers and the unused application-based inventory overload.

## Verification

Adds 12 regression tests covering shutdown, permission recovery, restoration ordering, concurrency limits, shared deadlines, cancellation, exact geometry queries and timer tolerance. All 967 tests pass locally in both normal and constrained-executor runs, alongside 13 Python tests, 24 Node.js tests and 3 WindowLab replay checks. Repeat review has no unresolved material findings.

The release workflow reruns the full CI tests, constrained-executor lifecycle checks, WindowLab replay, deployment compatibility, and Apple Silicon package verification before publication.

No new runtime dependencies, periodic polling or persistent background tasks are introduced. Restoration remains best effort for unavailable windows and reports incomplete work. Native CPU, RAM and energy use were not profiled.
